mapper.select: select biz_id as bizId, template_id as templateId, channel_type as channelType, message_type as messageType, receiver, receiver_count, title, content, delay_minutes as delayMinutes, schedule_time as scheduleTime, retry_count as retryCount, status, success_count, fail_count, send_time as sendTime, create_time as createTime from message_record where template_id = #{templateId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and (receiver = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or receiver = #{phone} or receiver = #{email} or message_type = 1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_record ( biz_id, template_id, channel_type, message_type, receiver, receiver_count, title, content, delay_minutes, schedule_time, retry_count, status, success_count, fail_count, send_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{bizId}, #{templateId}, #{channelType}, #{messageType}, #{receiver}, #{receiverCount}, #{title}, #{content}, #{delayMinutes}, #{scheduleTime}, #{retryCount}, #{status}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{sendTime}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT mr.*, mrd.read_status, mrd.read_time FROM doc.message_record mr LEFT JOIN doc.message_receiver_detail mrd ON mr.id = mrd.record_id AND mrd.receiver = #{userId} WHERE mr.id = #{id} AND mr.status = 60

SELECT mr.*, mrd.read_status, mrd.read_time FROM doc.message_record mr inner JOIN doc.message_template mt ON mr.template_id = mt.id left JOIN doc.message_receiver_detail mrd ON mr.id = mrd.record_id and mrd.receiver = #{userId} WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.message_type = 1 or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email}) AND mr.status = 60
AND mrd.read_status = 0
AND mt.msg_type = 10
AND mt.msg_type = 40
AND mt.msg_type = 50
AND mt.msg_type = 20
AND ( mr.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mr.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY mr.create_time ASC
ORDER BY mr.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc.message_record mr left JOIN doc.message_receiver_detail mrd ON mr.id = mrd.record_id WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email} or mr.message_type = 1) AND mr.status = 60
AND mrd.read_status = 0
AND mr.message_type = 10
AND mr.message_type = 40
AND mr.message_type = 50
AND ( mr.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR mr.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc.message_record mr WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email} or mr.message_type = 1) AND mr.status = 60

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc.message_record mr left JOIN doc.message_receiver_detail mrd ON mr.id = mrd.record_id WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email} or mr.message_type = 1) AND mr.status = 60 AND (mrd.read_status = 0 or mrd.read_status is null)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc.message_record mr inner join doc.message_template mt on mr.template_id = mt.id WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email} or mr.message_type = 1) AND mr.status = 60 AND mt.msg_type = 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc.message_record mr inner join doc.message_template mt on mr.template_id = mt.id WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email} or mr.message_type = 1) AND mr.status = 60 AND mt.msg_type = 40

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc.message_record mr inner join doc.message_template mt on mr.template_id = mt.id WHERE (mr.receiver = #{userId} or mr.receiver = #{phone} or mr.receiver = #{email} or mr.message_type = 1) AND mr.status = 60 AND mt.msg_type = 50
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM doc.message_record WHERE receiver = #{receiver} or receiver = #{phone} or receiver = #{email}
